source.what: One live chain walk: a real block fetched from a monerod over Tor, walked end to end through the proven pipeline (getBlock -> parseBlock -> getTransactions -> walkBlockTxs).
source.transport: curl --socks5-hostname via 127.0.0.1:9050 (Tor; the node saw a Tor exit, not this machine)
source.note: The node is a stranger and its claims are recorded as claims. Every id below is computed from bytes by the repo parser; claimedHash is what the node said and was cross-checked once, by the capture, against the proven id.
